title: Connectivity Engineer - Data Center Design, Engineering, & Construction
description:
Meta is seeking a Connectivity Engineer to join the Design Engineering and Construction (DEC) team. Our data centers are the foundation upon which our innovative services are delivered, and our rapidly scaling infrastructure operates. The team lights up Meta ’s global data centers, delivering the physical infrastructure that connects the world to the videos, feeds, and other information stored on Meta ’s server banks. The DEC Connectivity Engineer will provide site level support to ensure DEC telecommunication projects are being executed on schedule, within budget and at the level of quality specified. Connectivity Engineer will be the key point of contact for managing the full project life\-cycle including project kick\-off all the way through production turnover into operations. DEC Connectivity Engineer is highly collaborative with cross\-functional partners at the Data Center Headquarters, our on\-site contractor, and other data centers globally.

* Technical Reviews \- Establish milestones for equipment purchase and track and report against these milestones Assist with the selection and review of a contractor to support the structured cabling work within a data center
